description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_Resource_Uncompiled' which extends 'Smarty_Resource'. It provides base implementation for resource plugins within the Smarty templating system that do not utilize the compiler, including managing resource states and populating compiled file paths.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Uncompiled
classes.description: Abstract class representing uncompiled resource plugins in Smarty that do not utilize the compiler, providing mechanisms to populate compiled file paths and track resource states.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Populates the compiled object with the filepath, timestamp, and file dependencies based on the source template and resource handler conditions.
